critique: The render strongly captures the intended Mapped Strings structure and motion: black background, full-frame wandering particle paths, a convincing mix of dotted and continuous strands, and turbulent clusters that reorganize substantially from t1 to t4. The current hue is much closer to the intended cyan/teal character. However, dense knots and several continuous segments still reach bright cyan-white, reducing strand separation compared with the more controlled, darker mapped-color appearance of the preset reference.

suggestions.why: Lower maximum particle opacity to prevent bright intersections from blooming into near-white knots and preserve separation between overlapping strings.
Slightly darken and deepen the flat teal base color so the brightest regions remain cyan rather than reading as mint/white.
